name: Natalya Chekhova
source:
Natalya Chekhova is now the fully brainwashed sex slave of Dario Dalisso.

Note that she does not show up in the game. Her character sprite only appears in the credits of the game.

The game confirms that Natalya Chekhova has completely retired from being a pilot on Dario's orders. The reason for this is due to him wanting to keep his sex slave safe as pilot's die all the time in this universe. 

The retirement notice notes that Natalya has received an award for her prior service to the Alliance (from before she was brainwashed to serve Dario). 

It is also confirmed that Natalya is now living as a stay at home sex slave, to Dario Dalisso, and has had a daughter with him.
